title: Alcohol (Condition)
html:
This article is about the condition applied by consuming alcohol. For the equivalent condition applied though spells and other features, see Drunk (Condition). For items that interact with it, see Drunk set.

Alcohol

  • Has  Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.

Properties

UID: DRINK_ALCOHOL

 Stack ID: DRINK

 Status groups: SG_Drunk

 More properties:
  • DisableCombatlog

Notes

  • Duration: 2 turns turns of this condition are applied whenever consuming one of the many alcoholic Camp Supplies.
  •  Cheeky Tipple grants immunity to the negative effects of this condition.

Condition Effects
Alcohol
